sections.title: Complete Demo
sections.body:
```python name=memory_agents/main.py
"""Run all memory + context engineering demos."""
import asyncio
from agents.memory_agent_base        import FullMemoryAgent
from agents.langgraph_memory_agent   import langgraph_memory_demo

def demo_full_memory_agent():
    print("\n" + "="*55)
    print("🧠 Full Memory Agent — All Memory Types")
    print("="*55)

    agent = FullMemoryAgent(
        name              = "Atlas",
        user_id           = "user_alice",
        context_strategy  = "hybrid",
    )

    # Manually store some long-term memories
    agent.remember("User prefers Python over JavaScript", importance=0.8)
    agent.remember("User is building an AI agent system",  importance=0.9)
    agent.remember("User prefers Azure OpenAI",            importance=0.7)

    # Multi-turn conversation
    turns = [
        "Hi! I'm Alice. What do you know about me?",
        "Can you remind me of my tech preferences?",
        "What agent frameworks should I use for my project?",
        "I prefer LangGraph over LangChain for stateful agents.",
        "What have we discussed so far in this session?",
        "Write a Python snippet for a simple memory store.",
        "What do you now know about my preferences?",
    ]

    for msg in turns:
        agent.chat(msg)

    # End session and consolidate
    agent.end_session()

    # New session — check if memory persists
    print("\n\n🔄 Starting NEW session — testing memory persistence...")
    agent2 = FullMemoryAgent(
        name    = "Atlas",
        user_id = "user_alice",
    )
    agent2.chat("Do you remember anything about me from before?")
    agent2.chat("What are my known preferences?")

async def demo_all():
    # 1. Full memory agent (all types)
    demo_full_memory_agent()

    # 2. LangGraph memory agent
    await langgraph_memory_demo()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(demo_all())
```

┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│            MEMORY TYPES — WHEN TO USE WHAT                       │
├─────────────────┬────────────────────┬───────────────────────────┤
│ Memory Type     │ Storage            │ Use When                  │
├─────────────────┼────────────────────┼───────────────────────────┤
│ Working         │ Context window     │ Current LLM call          │
│ Short-term      │ Redis/in-memory    │ Current session           │
│ Long-term       │ Vector DB + SQL    │ Cross-session facts        │
│ Episodic        │ SQLite event log   │ "What happened before"    │
│ Semantic        │ Vector embeddings  │ Domain knowledge (RAG)    │
│ Procedural      │ System prompt      │ Tools, rules, skills      │
└─────────────────┴────────────────────┴───────────────────────────┘

┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│           CONTEXT ENGINEERING STRATEGIES                          │
├──────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Strategy         │ Best For                                       │
├──────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Selective        │ Many sources, tight budget                     │
│ Compressed       │ All info needed but too long                   │
│ Hierarchical     │ Clear priority tiers                           │
│ Temporal         │ Time-sensitive tasks                           │
│ Hybrid           │ Production — smartest overall                  │
└──────────────────┴───────────────────────────────────────────────┘
